div.div:
Snapshot request checkpoint
- If the Kafka position was not saved, the connector can read the request again.
- If the Kafka position was saved before snapshot progress, an operator may need to send the request again.
- Neither checkpoint proves which snapshot rows reached workflow-transitions.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 528px; height: 1px; padding-top: 950px; margin-left: 53px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Recovery limits
- Azure SQL CDC must still contain the saved log position.
- Losing connect-offsets or schema history is a different incident.
- Do not change the Azure SQL table schema during a snapshot.
- Normal resume is the documented design. Issue 68 has not yet proved it with containers.
